scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:web

scripts.build:web: npm run build --workspace @sidequest/contracts && npm run build --workspace @sidequest/web
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build --workspace @sidequest/contracts && npm run deploy:cf --workspace @sidequest/web
